name: hiclim-as-daily-cmip6
title: HiClim-AS - Daily Bias-Corrected and Statistically Downscaled CMIP6 Climate Projections for South America
description:
HiClim-AS is a daily climate projection dataset for South America built from 10 selected CMIP6 models. Each model simulation was bias-adjusted and statistically downscaled to a regular 0.1° latitude-longitude grid with ISIMIP3BASD (Lange, 2019), using MERGE (precipitation) and ERA5 (temperature) as reference datasets.

Variables: precipitation (pr); daily mean, maximum and minimum near-surface (2 m) air temperature (tas, tasmax, tasmin); and potential evapotranspiration (pet), computed with the Hargreaves method (Hargreaves and Samani, 1985).

Experiments: historical (1981-2014) and SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5 (2015-2100).

Each model simulation is distributed individually, with its CMIP6 variant label (r*i*p*f*) preserved, as one Zarr store per variable, model, experiment and member. Each STAC Item groups one model, experiment and member, with one asset per variable.

Native model calendars differ: 360-day for HadGEM3-GC31-MM and UKESM1-1-LL, 365-day (no leap) for GFDL-ESM4 and NorESM2-MM, Gregorian for the others. Check the calendar attribute of the time coordinate in each store before computing day-count indices.

Reference: Shimizu et al. (2026).
